cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Truth or Loyalty
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between protecting the relationship and answering a dangerous question honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you answer Mum about the vase, remember you promised to cover for me. Answer her question, not the one you imagine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asking whether the cleaner broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say no. Excellent: accurate, and you've kept your promise.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's also asking whether you did.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One question at a time, please. Are you giving Mum a complete statement, or keeping your word to your brother?

reason: Final spoken-language reread found A1's before-Mum-asks timing distracts from B2's current question. Change only A1 to before-you-answer; preserve the promise, scope instruction and all subsequent turns.
